:::{#me}
Hi! My name is Kalina. I am a first year master student at the University of New Hampshire. I am in the Ecological Behavior and Acoustic lab. For my thesis, I am studying bat distribution in the White Mountains.


## Goals
My goal is to determine different covariates that make up a successful habitat for bat species. This is a side project to my thesis: I am interested in why populations are successful and how to replicate that success elsewhere.

## Education
B.S. Ecology and Environmental Sciences, University of Maine

B.A. Economics, University of Maine

## Experience
Scientific writing :)
